original_description: Create and edit 3D names from your conversation. Choose fonts, colors, thickness and bases for name signs, keychains, pet tags, cake toppers and two-name flip designs. Refine the interactive preview, then connect a NameSTL account to save and reopen designs. Export STL and 3MF files when your connected account has export access. NameSTL explains account access limits when a download is unavailable. File preparation uses a WebGL-capable browser; set the final print size in your slicer. NameSTL creates model files for you to print yourself.
summary_ja: 名前入りの3Dプリント用デザインを作成し、プレビュー・保存。
limitations: 保存・再読込にはアカウント接続が必要。STL・3MFの書き出しはアカウントのアクセス権に依存。WebGL対応ブラウザが必要。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
